connectionTypes.sourceNote: PRIMARY — UERC order on UPCL's True up for FY 2024-25, APR for FY 2025-26 and ARR for FY 2026-27, Annexure 1 'Rate Schedule Effective from 01.04.2026', RTS-1 Domestic, '1.2 Other Domestic Consumers': Rs 3.65/kWh up to 100 units/month, Rs 5.25 for 101-200, Rs 7.15 for 201-400, Rs 7.80 above 400. Fixed charge is per kW of sanctioned load per month and tiered by load: Rs 75/kW up to 1 kW, Rs 85/kW above 1 kW and up to 4 kW, Rs 100/kW above 4 kW. Only the middle tier (Rs 85/kW) is modelled, so this understates the fixed charge above 4 kW (by Rs 15/kW) and overstates it at exactly 1 kW or below (by Rs 10/kW). BPL/lifeline (Rs 18/connection + Rs 1.85/kWh, load up to 1 kW and up to 60 units/month) and RTS-1A snowbound (Rs 1.85/kWh) not modelled. Source: https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s303412aef4dcdee4f934f7bf599f89783/uploads/2026/04/20260407394034625.pdf (linked from https://upcl.uk.gov.in/electricity-tariff-orders/).

PRIMARY — UPCL/UERC tariff filing (UERC petition document, citing the 'Existing' tariff in effect per the Tariff Order dated 11.04.2025 for FY2025-26), RTS-2 'Non-Domestic Consumer', category '2.2 Other non-Domestic Users, Others upto 25kW not covered in 2.1': Rs 110/kW/month fixed, Rs 7.75/kWh flat (not slabbed). Other RTS-2 tiers not modelled: Govt/Educational/Hospital institutions (upto 25kW: Rs 90/kW fixed + Rs 6.00/kWh; above 25kW: Rs 100/kVA fixed + Rs 5.85/kVAh), small-load exemption (upto 4kW & consumption upto 60 units/month: Rs 90/kW fixed + Rs 5.75/kWh), above 25kW (Rs 115/kVA fixed + Rs 7.80/kVAh), Single Point Bulk Supply, and Independent Advertisement Hoardings (Rs 140/kW + Rs 8.60/kWh). Source: https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3cf05968255451bdefe3c5bc64d550517/uploads/2025/12/20251226266181352.pdf (UERC petition document tabulating Existing vs Proposed FY2026-27 rates; the Existing column reflects the current approved FY2025-26 tariff).

PRIMARY — same UERC document, RTS-5 'HT & LT Industry', 'Total LT — LT Industries (upto 75kW) — Normal Hours' (existing FY2025-26 rate): Rs 185/kVA/month fixed, Rs 5.75/kVAh energy; rate is per kVA of contract demand, applied here via the perLoad/perKW field per this dataset's convention. Peak-hour (Rs 7.48/kVAh) and off-peak (Rs 4.31/kVAh) time-of-day rates not modelled — this uses the Normal-Hours rate as representative. Source: https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3cf05968255451bdefe3c5bc64d550517/uploads/2025/12/20251226266181352.pdf.

PRIMARY — same UERC document, RTS-4 'Private Tubewells/Pumping Sets', '1. Metered' (existing FY2025-26 rate): Rs 2.70/kWh, no separate fixed/demand charge listed for this category. RTS-4A 'Agriculture Allied Services' (a related but distinct category for higher-load/agro-processing connections) not modelled: Metered upto 25kW: Rs 3.80/kWh, no fixed charge; 25-75kW: Rs 75/kVA fixed + Rs 3.80/kVAh; above 75kW: Rs 100/kVA fixed + Rs 4.00/kVAh. Source: https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3cf05968255451bdefe3c5bc64d550517/uploads/2025/12/20251226266181352.pdf.

verifiedBy: PRIMARY for residential slabs and fixed-charge rate (UERC rate schedule effective 01.04.2026, RTS-1) — see the residential sourceNote. Electricity duty, green energy cess and the monthly FPPCA are NOT modelled; the load-tiered fixed charge is modelled at the Rs 85/kW middle tier only.
